factory_title: Customer Journey, First Value & Outcome Integrity
scope: Repository-derived customer journey composition evidence only. This registry does not replace owner authority for Auth, Source Health, Decision Intelligence, Billing, Notification, State Machines, Privacy, Persistence, Golden or Release.

edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: Customer reaches the ObraSignal Web entrypoint.
edges.OWNER: Web/Release authority; this Factory owns composition evidence only.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: The primary Web entry reaches the current supported product shell rather than a legacy dashboard.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Legacy or stale entrypoint is presented as the current product.
edges.RECOVERY: Reload or return to the supported Web entrypoint; physical availability remains Golden/Release evidence.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: No tenant state may be exposed before authenticated identity is established.
EVIDENCE: repository wiring present; physical deployed entry requires external Golden/Release verification

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Sign in and establish the correct account context.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: Protected requests use the current authenticated identity; logout/login cannot reuse a prior account token.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Stale or wrong-tenant token reaches protected customer data.
edges.RECOVERY: Auth refresh/re-authentication according to Auth authority.
EVIDENCE: repository session and API guards exist; provider-backed physical sign-in remains external acceptance

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Describe the company well enough to receive account-specific opportunity intelligence.
edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: Authenticated account has no usable name/activity profile or opens profile editing.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: Invalid profile data is rejected; successful save is durable and returned as the current account profile.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Profile appears saved while persistence/recalculation failed, or stale cached profile is presented as freshly confirmed.
edges.RECOVERY: Visible save failure and server-backed retry; cached profile is not fresh authority.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: Profile is scoped by authenticated account_id.
EVIDENCE: API round-trip and invalid-profile rejection are executable; complete customer comprehension is Golden/product evidence

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: See opportunity decisions that reflect the profile just saved.
edges.OWNER: Cross-owner composition: Profile + Decision Intelligence; this Factory owns journey causality evidence.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: A successful profile save does not leave old account-specific decisions masquerading as current; Radar refresh follows server recalculation.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Successful profile save returns before recalculation or UI keeps stale decision state as current.
edges.RECOVERY: Server-backed refresh after durable profile save; failure remains visible and retryable.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: Recalculation and Radar reads use the same authenticated account_id.
CURRENT_TEST: tests/test_profile_api.py asserts bootstrap_account is invoked before success response
mobile/p0-regressions.test.mjs asserts save awaits server-backed Radar refresh
EVIDENCE: structural causal seam is guarded; full profile-mutation -> changed decision -> rendered Radar scenario remains unproven as one executable journey

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Understand whether no visible results means no current match, filtering, or unconfirmed system/source coverage.
edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: Radar request yields zero visible opportunities or stats/source evidence is unavailable/stale.
edges.OWNER: Customer truth composition; Source Health owns freshness semantics; Web owns rendering.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: Zero results never silently prove zero market; stale/degraded/unavailable/unknown coverage remains explicit and true zero remains distinct from missing stats.
ACTION_AVAILABLE: adjust filters when filters caused empty state
continue when a truthful current no-match is established
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Canonical main renders missing statistics as zero and a generic empty-state instruction without source-specific coverage authority.
edges.RECOVERY: Consume public Source Health contract and preserve UNKNOWN; independent Golden accepts the composed customer experience.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: Opportunity/stat reads remain authenticated and account-scoped; source health is operational truth, not a tenant selector.
CURRENT_TEST: mobile/p0-regressions.test.mjs has no canonical false-zero/source-health composition guard
EVIDENCE: canonical main still lacks composed source-health customer truth
#399 exact integration 44ca24fbe2862e1a79231ec1f2b811bcbdbbbb3b is non-canonical and Quality-green
edges.BLOCKER: Independent Golden acceptance and explicit canonical authorization; #399 is not merged.
edges.REOPEN_CONDITION: Golden acceptance/rejection, any input-head drift, or canonical main movement affecting this edge.

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Identify an opportunity worth inspecting without stronger claims than the decision authority supports.
edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: Radar returns one or more account-visible opportunities.
edges.OWNER: Web presentation + Decision Intelligence semantics; this Factory owns customer-truth continuity.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: Score is relevance/compatibility evidence, not probability; unknown reason/score/actionability is not fabricated; closed opportunity is not presented as actionable.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Fallback score/reason/source labels create stronger customer meaning than backend authority proves.
edges.RECOVERY: Render explicit unknown/unsupported states and open server-backed current detail.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: Account-specific decision belongs to the authenticated account.
EVIDENCE: #298 carries bounded customer-truth repairs but is non-canonical; canonical detail refresh is guarded

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Understand what the opportunity is, why it matters, whether it is current/actionable, and what to do next.
edges.OWNER: Cross-owner presentation: Web + Decision + Lifecycle + Source; this Factory owns journey completion.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: Opening a card resolves current server-backed detail; unavailable/deleted detail does not silently reuse the stale list card.
ACTION_AVAILABLE: open available source link when provenance supports it
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Stale list snapshot is treated as current detail or missing authority is replaced with a convenient default.
edges.RECOVERY: Retry current detail; 404/unavailable remains explicit; historical claims stay qualified.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: Current decision/workflow are resolved for authenticated account.
EVIDENCE: server-backed refresh is guarded; complete WHAT/WHY/CURRENT/ACTIONABLE/NEXT customer acceptance remains broader than subsystem tests

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Save an interesting opportunity and reliably return to it for review.
edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: Customer decides an inspected opportunity deserves later review but is not necessarily a pursuit.
edges.OWNER: Watchlist/Saved owner; this Factory owns journey continuity only.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: Save is distinct from pursuit, tenant-safe, durable across reload/login, and retrievable from a coherent Saved return path.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Canonical product has no established Saved journey; a stale prebuild contract is treated as current product capability.
edges.RECOVERY: Reanchor and integrate the owner contract before building return UX; do not create a parallel saved truth.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: Saved membership must be account-scoped and server-authoritative.
CURRENT_TEST: canonical main has opportunity_workflow but no canonical watchlist endpoint/UI
EVIDENCE: #150 head 879ef88233d9b86f9905e7281409b8897e4f4a89 implements tenant-safe watchlist v0 on a stale base
Persistence #238 explicitly requires #150 reanchor before integration
edges.BLOCKER: Owner reanchor/integration; dedicated Saved-list return surface is not part of #150 v0.
edges.REOPEN_CONDITION: Watchlist owner publishes a current-main candidate or Integration Lab selects a current exact tree.

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Record explicit review/pursuit progress and resume it later.
edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: Customer chooses to track an opportunity beyond inspection.
edges.OWNER: State Machine/Workflow semantics; this Factory owns journey continuity.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: Workflow state is durable and tenant-safe but never claims real-world bid progress beyond the state-machine authority.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Arbitrary state changes or lifecycle labels are interpreted as proven real-world progress.
edges.RECOVERY: Owner-defined transition/precondition validation; failed write preserves prior confirmed state.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: Workflow relation is scoped by authenticated account_id.
EVIDENCE: tenant-scoped persistence exists; current canonical tests validate allowed labels but do not prove an owner-defined transition graph or real-world progress

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Return from an alert to the correct current opportunity and take a meaningful action.
edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: A relevant opportunity event has produced a supported customer notification.
edges.OWNER: Notification delivery + Auth + Web/Mobile return composition; this Factory owns customer-outcome continuity.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: Notification delivery is not value by itself; tap resolves the correct tenant and current opportunity truth rather than replaying historical stale state.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Historical push payload is treated as current authority or background/closed-app delivery is inferred from repository-only tests.
edges.RECOVERY: Resolve current server authority on open; unsupported/denied notification state remains explicit.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: Device/event/account binding must not cross tenants.
CURRENT_TEST: repository notification/API wiring only; real background tap remains physical-device acceptance
EVIDENCE: #298 explicitly leaves #263 background/closed-app notification tap return REAL_DEVICE_ONLY

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Return after interruption and resume from truthful current state.
edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: Customer reloads, reopens, signs back in, or returns after time has passed.
edges.OWNER: Cross-owner journey composition; cache/storage owners retain local persistence semantics.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: Cache may accelerate display but never becomes current authority; fresh request replaces cache and failure discloses possible staleness.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Hydrated cache is silently presented as current or account A cache survives into account B journey.
edges.RECOVERY: Server refresh plus tenant-safe cache invalidation/partitioning according to storage/session owners.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: A->B transition must not expose prior-account profile/Radar/saved state.
CURRENT_TEST: mobile/p0-regressions.test.mjs proves cache-first then fresh replacement/error disclosure at wiring level
EVIDENCE: fresh replacement behavior exists; same-device A->B local-storage safety and source-currentness composition are separate owner/integration obligations

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Receive a trustworthy, understandable opportunity outcome and a meaningful next action without founder intervention.
edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: Authenticated legitimate company has a valid profile and reaches Radar.
edges.OWNER: This Factory owns the composite outcome; component semantics remain with specialist owners.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: A populated trustworthy Radar with at least one understandable actionable opportunity can be first value; a truthful current no-match is valid product behavior but is not silently fabricated from unknown coverage.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Login/page load/Radar load is counted as value, or unknown source/decision state is converted into a convincing outcome.
edges.RECOVERY: Preserve uncertainty, route owner defects, and continue only when the customer can understand a truthful next action.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: All company-specific inputs and decisions remain bound to authenticated account.
CURRENT_TEST: composed repository evidence across profile, decision, Radar and detail; no single canonical first-value acceptance scenario yet
EVIDENCE: candidate definition retained as hypothesis until deterministic end-to-end journey fixture and Golden acceptance exist

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Return because ObraSignal has materially useful new current information or ongoing work to continue.
edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: Customer has already received an initial useful outcome.
edges.OWNER: This Factory owns repeat-value journey integrity; Source/Notification/Workflow/Saved owners retain their contracts.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: A second value event must be materially new/current and reduce effort or enable action; notification count or page visits are not repeat value.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Engagement activity is relabeled as repeat value without a customer outcome.
edges.RECOVERY: Build deterministic second-value scenarios after the canonical Saved/source-update/return contracts are available.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: Return state and new information remain account-scoped where customer-specific.
CURRENT_TEST: no canonical deterministic repeat-value scenario identified at this exact main
EVIDENCE: repository has ingredients such as Radar refresh, workflow and notifications, but no proven composite second-value contract

edges.CUSTOMER_INTENT: Understand enough recurring value to make a rational subscription decision.
edges.ENTRY_CONDITION: Customer has experienced demonstrated product value and reaches an entitlement/billing boundary.
edges.OWNER: Product/Billing/GTM own commercial policy and evidence; this Factory owns journey continuity.
edges.EXPECTED_CUSTOMER_TRUTH: Subscription capability is not willingness to pay and billing state must not contradict customer access/account lifecycle truth.
edges.FAILURE_MODE: Payment machinery or feature usage is treated as product-market-fit evidence.
edges.RECOVERY: Keep pricing/WTP hypotheses separate and consume Billing/GTM authority when evidence exists.
edges.TENANT_BOUNDARY: Entitlement and subscription state belong to the authenticated account.
CURRENT_TEST: commercial-value journey not yet reconstructed to executable acceptance at canonical main
EVIDENCE: intentionally not inferred from existing billing APIs or usage
